summary: BPC-157 is a peptide in the repair & anti inflammatory class (unclear; NO-system and growth-factor pathways proposed). Europe PMC indexes 228 publications naming it or a listed alias in a title or abstract, including 0 randomized controlled trials and 0 clinical trials of any design, as of 2026-09-09. The strongest evidence tier in that literature is observational human studies, with no indexed randomized trial. This page reports what those studies state, sentence by sentence, with each statement tied to its source and labeled by the kind of evidence it is. It does not recommend use, and it does not translate study doses into anything personal.

faq.question: Has BPC-157 been tested in humans?
faq.answer: Not in any indexed clinical trial. The studies in this record's ledger report work in humans, mice, rats. Any human dosing information circulating about BPC-157 does not come from a published trial.

faq.question: What kind of evidence exists for BPC-157?
faq.answer: The strongest tier is observational human: observational human studies, with no indexed randomized trial. Every claim on this page carries its own tier, because a compound with one human trial and forty animal studies is described by both facts, not the better one.

faq.question: Is BPC-157 an approved medicine?
faq.answer: ChEMBL records CHEMBL4297358 at maximum clinical phase 1, with no approval recorded. Approval status differs by jurisdiction and is pending human review on this record.

faq.question: Which species has BPC-157 been studied in?
faq.answer: Studies in this record's ledger report work in: Humans, Mice, Rats. Findings in one species do not transfer to another, and weight-normalized doses in particular do not scale linearly between them.
